foe-velociraptor.what_i_see: A lean bipedal raptor dinosaur with green and yellow-tan stripes stands upright with an elongated snout and raised three-clawed hands.

foe-ankylosaurus.what_i_see: I see a low quadrupedal Ankylosaurus standing on four separate legs with a straight tail ending in a large bony club, displaying a green spiked armour plate along its back.

foe-spinosaurus.what_i_see: I see a bipedal green Spinosaurus standing upright on two chunky hind legs with hands clasped at its chest, a long crocodile snout, and a tall spiky dorsal sail.

foe-stegosaurus.what_i_see: A green Stegosaurus walking to the right with four distinct legs, two alternating rows of upright plates, a small nasal horn, and two pairs of tail spikes.

foe-brontosaurus.what_i_see: A chunky green sauropod with a rounded cranial crest standing on four thick pillar legs with a raised neck and a tail curling forward above the ground.

foe-pterodactyl.what_i_see: A green and tan Pteranodon standing stably on four separate legs with folded wings, a long serrated beak, and an elongated swept-back crest.

foe-quetzalcoatlus.what_i_see: A giant Quetzalcoatlus standing tall on four sturdy pillar legs with a very long upright neck, folded wings along its sides, and an enormous pointed beak with a red crest.

foe-pterodactyl-fly.what_i_see: A chunky painted pterosaur flying with wings spread wide, featuring a prominent long yellow beak pointing to the side and a back-swept crest in a sculpted miniature style.

foe-quetzalcoatlus-fly.what_i_see: A giant Quetzalcoatlus flying head-on with two huge wings spread wide, an enormous beak pointing downward, a long neck, and a visible tail, rendered as a chunky 3D painted miniature.
